scope: Manually transcribed reference header facts; no owned-board identity, electrical migration, wiring or qualification.

sources.location: Page 1 header labels/raw GPIO/default buses; page 3 advanced pin notes
Sheet 1: JP1/JP2 header numbering, GPIO0/46 boot straps, LED and USB nets; drawing V0.3 / ABX00083 and ABX00092
GPIO Summary: strapping GPIO0/3/45/46; USB-JTAG GPIO19/20; flash/PSRAM GPIO26..37

policy_reserved_header_labels.D0: Preserve the reference UART RX route for service; V1 policy, not a silicon prohibition.
policy_reserved_header_labels.D1: Preserve the reference UART TX route (499 ohm series resistor); V1 policy.
policy_reserved_header_labels.A2: GPIO3 is a strapping pin; exclude it until reset-time behavior is separately qualified.
policy_reserved_header_labels.B0: GPIO46 is a strapping pin and on-board RGB red route; V1 exclusion.
policy_reserved_header_labels.B1: GPIO0 is a strapping pin and on-board RGB green route; V1 exclusion. Legacy schematic label RESETN here is not the system RESET pin.

shared_header_functions.D13: GPIO48 also drives the on-board SCK LED; loading and signaling are unqualified.

limitations: Header references identify manufacturer drawing pins, not a qualified carrier footprint or measured owned board.
The latest pinout calls JP1.3 B0 and JP1.13 B1; the reference schematic retains legacy AREF and RESETN names at those positions.
Default bus pins are a bounded review policy. ESP32-S3 GPIO matrix remaps require a separate proposal and qualification.
Logic, power-up state, pulls, drive, timing, bus loading and current are not qualified by this pin map.
